11044|0556ba58.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|0556ba58.text:
Have you now? This certainly doesn't look like something I had asked for.

This potion is clearly inert, meaning it will no longer create reactions. Hence it is of no use to my studies.

Take it back to Alessandro. Perhaps next time he sends me a potion he can find someone with faster feet.

<Doctor Felben waves a dismissive hand.>

11044|386a9ec7.name: Doctor Martin Felben
11044|386a9ec7.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $N, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

1499|9cb5b422.name: Magistrate Sevren
1499|9cb5b422.text: Ah, you there!  I have tasks to give, and I need not waste time explaining their crucial nature.  Listen close.

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

246349|da04ef25.name: Breton Samuels
246349|da04ef25.text:
If you've come seeking the fellowship of your fellow paladins, you've come to the right place. 

Welcome home.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

246389|b676ae27.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|b676ae27.text:
A little bit of a lot of things. Mostly I take the soft and weak and reshape them into hardened fighters once again.

It's a tough world out there, and even our own people mistrust us. We need to be tough and self-reliant if we are to fit into this "Horde" with the rest of our people.

246393|4b78c376.name: Jorin Croge
246393|4b78c376.text: There are many things lurking out there in the dark and the light is needed now more than ever. If only these poor souls could see that just because our world has changed doesn't mean we have to be the monsters that the living think we are.

246393|533ec9c8.name: Jorin Croge
246393|533ec9c8.text:
I make sure we are provisioned and that the scant resources we do have are distributed properly.

If this were a proper order, I'd be something of a quartermaster. Such as we are, however, I just do my best to make sure we are at least somewhat equipped to deal with the dangers all around us.

246394|63539e70.name: Ander Solliden
246394|63539e70.text: In my previous life, I lived nearby here. I still wander the fields of my childhood farmstead occasionally. It fills me with sadness to see those I knew and loved, shambling around as mindless thralls. It pains me, but it's that very pain that gives me strength and purpose.

246394|82d61c10.name: Ander Solliden
246394|82d61c10.text:
Mostly the usual. Murloc attacks, the occasional Scarlet Crusade skirmish. There are even some paladins that can't quite adjust to life as a Forsaken. Far too often we have to put those down that turn their blades upon their brothers. 

By far the worst is when some mindless thrall wanders too close. I can kill murlocs all day, but some of the scourge I've had to destroy were former friends of mine. Some were even family members.

I'd rather it be me who puts them down than some random adventurer, but it still stings.

276067|2af62916.name: Angus Hammerhand
276067|2af62916.text:
It's my job to get the Paladins of Bandarion Keep set up with proper arms and armor. It's not much, but it's honest work.

I've got a thing or two for sale as well, should you need gear.

276110|2fc3ff64.name: Knight of Mourning
276110|2fc3ff64.text: My oath binds me to this place. What brings you here, to this light-forsaken place?

4605|3a5f002e.name: Basil Frye
4605|3a5f002e.text: You are not trying to kill the anvil with your hammer, you are trying to create a weapon to kill your foes with. Let me show you what you are doing wrong.

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

5759|a28d29e1.name: Nurse Neela
5759|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

7683|a4ef73af.name: Alessandro Luca
7683|a4ef73af.text: Welcome to Blue Moon Odds and Ends, $c.  If you have any questions, please let me know.

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

405-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
405-progress.text:
Greetings.  Either you do not know who I am, or your business with me is urgent.

Because if neither of these were true, then you would not be foolish enough to disturb me...
405-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich

79095-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79095-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79095-progress.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

97952-complete.name: Basil Frye
97952-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97952-complete.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

99141-progress.name: Executor Zygand
99141-progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141-progress.title: Patience

99144-accept.name: Bareth Dawnstone
99144-accept.text:
Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all we stand for!

<Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.>

Our ranks are thin. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
99144-accept.title: Seeking Refuge
